blocks.orig: Lake Manyara National Park’s walking safari takes you through tropical forests and acacia woodlands via various natural hiking trails. A guide and armed ranger come along to ensure your safety and to lead the way along areas with a high concentration of wildlife. Don’t be suprised if you encounter animals such as monkeys, zebras, gazelles, giraffes, elephants, different species of birds and more!
blocks.html: On the walking safari in Lake Manyara National Park, you follow a number of natural hiking trails through acacia woodlands and tropical forests. You are accompanied by a guide and an armed ranger, who keep you safe and show you the way through areas where wildlife is plentiful. Don’t be surprised if you come across monkeys, zebras, gazelles, giraffes, elephants, many kinds of birds and more!
